name: Lapse changes only the selected standing holding

statusDetails.message: After advancing past the recorded lapse deadline, b1 is lapsed, b2 remains confirmed, and posted and billing views contain only b2.

labels.value: Scarcity notice on a standing holding

labels.name: story
labels.value: Choosing and losing a holding are different events

steps.name: Given one of a household's two standing holdings was selected under notice
Then the household loses the selected standing holding
Then its other standing holding remains held
Then the posted list and billing signal reflect the same holding history
